dogecoin.text: @WholeMarsBlog @elonmusk I'm a huge Elon believer, but public dogecoin advocacy feels irresponsible to me.
@Drift0r I understand Tesla and its mission.  What the hell is dogecoin about?

Came across this consideration in a tweet from @jpr007 .  It's been stewing within me for a few days and seems to make eminent sense.  Hoping that dogecoin is a passing side "hustle".  Tesla is the mission.

@MilMileBattery Rather than wasting time on dogecoin why not make Tesla shares your fiat currency.  It has genuine value. Quite likely to rise faster than inflation.  It is regulated and can't be voted out of existence.  The total number of shares is manageable.  Backstopped by the best products
